title: Dashboard render output
description: A composed metric-overview dashboard: the resolved abstract layout, per-panel compiled payloads (chart specs / KPI values / a11y-described error placeholders), the declared cross-filter links, the dashboard-level a11y block, and ONE dashboard-level specRef for pipeline reuse. Per-panel viz.render specRefs are suppressed; geo panels preserve their echartsSpec.__registration FeatureCollection.

status.description: Whether the dashboard composed successfully (ok even when individual panels failed to a placeholder).

panels.description: Per-panel compiled results, in declared panel order. A chart panel carries its compiled spec; a kpi panel carries computed values; a failed panel becomes an a11y-described error placeholder (onPanelError default).

layout.description: The resolved abstract grid placements (m02), one per rendered panel.

links.description: The declared cross-filter links (echoed). The cross-filter resolver applies any active 'selection' to each panel before render.

tokenCssRef.description: Deferred token CSS reference when compact mode is on (use tokens.build).

html.description: Opt-in self-contained HTML export (sprint-115), present only when input output.html=true. A single HTML document with the metric-overview panels composed per the resolved layout: Vega-Lite panels rendered to inline SVG (@oods/viz-render), KPI tiles, and an a11y-described placeholder for ECharts-primary (geo) panels. Absent leaves the rest of the payload byte-identical.

specRef.description: One dashboard-level reference to the composed payload for pipeline reuse.

crossFiltered.description: True when an active selection was applied.

panelResult.description: A compiled panel result — chart, kpi, or error placeholder (discriminated on 'kind').

spec.description: Compiled Vega-Lite spec (tabular), or {} for ECharts-primary panels.

echartsSpec.description: Compiled ECharts option (ECharts-primary panels + opt-in tabular). Geo panels carry the FeatureCollection on echartsSpec.__registration.

errorPanelResult.description: Partial-panel error policy (SEAM b, default 'placeholder'): a panel that failed to render, kept in-place and a11y-described, so it does not void the dashboard.

panelOrder.description: Panel ids in reading/focus order (KPI row first by default).
